howTo.title: How it works
howTo.item1: Both surcharges appear as their own line items in the cart — logistic surcharge and cash-on-delivery fee, each switchable on its own.
howTo.item2: The logistic surcharge disappears automatically once no regular products remain in the cart; the cash-on-delivery fee once a different payment method is chosen.
howTo.item3: The cash-on-delivery payment method is selected under Cash on delivery payment method. If none is selected, it is recognised by its name: it has to contain "Nachnahme", "cash on delivery" or the word "COD".
howTo.item4: The tax rate follows the items in the cart; Default tax rate only applies when nothing can be derived from them.
howTo.item5: The amounts apply per sales channel — the selector sits at the top of this page.

info.description: Automatically adds configurable surcharges to the cart: a logistic flat fee per order and a cash-on-delivery fee for the matching payment method, each with its own tax rate.
